description:
Rotate Pilot helps you study for FAA knowledge tests right in ChatGPT: the Part 107 drone test and the Private, Instrument, Commercial and ATP written tests.

• Practice questions in the real test's 3-option format, with explanations and 14 CFR / AIM / ACS references. Quiz mode hides the answer until you reply.
• A readiness diagnostic that scores you per area against the 70% pass mark (for Part 107, weighted like the real test).
• Official test facts with sources: questions, time limit, pass mark, retest rules and 2025 national pass rates, plus what a failed attempt costs.
• A dated study plan to your test day.
• Plain-English METAR and TAF decoding (live from NOAA) and the drone airspace class and LAANC ceiling at any US ZIP code.

Free and read-only, no sign-in. Rotate Pilot is independent and not affiliated with the FAA or PSI.

defaultPrompt: Am I ready for the Part 107 drone test?
Quiz me on Private Pilot weather questions
What airspace is my ZIP code in for flying a drone?
